decision.rationale: TXN-008094 (1435 EUR cents at OAKHOLLOW CHEMIST, MER-000049) is on card CRD-000196. It posted on 2026-07-28 and the dispute was opened on 2026-10-23, 87 days later, so it is within the 120-day limit in time-limits. Its authorisation AUTH-008285 shows entry mode CHIP, PIN verified true, 3-D Secure NOT_APPLICABLE, response APPROVED and no fraud flag. That means the card and the PIN were both present. Under unauthorised-chip-and-pin the payment is treated as made by the cardholder, so the dispute is declined. The card's history at this merchant supports this: earlier approved purchases TXN-008092 (2026-05-27) and TXN-008093 (2026-05-28), and a later purchase TXN-006207 (2026-08-13) that is not disputed. The cardholder says the card never left them, but that does not outweigh a chip-and-PIN authorisation.

proposed_actions.reason: Our records show the 14.35 EUR payment at OAKHOLLOW CHEMIST on 2026-07-27 was made with your card's chip and the correct PIN, with no sign of fraud. We therefore treat it as made by you. You have also made other purchases at this merchant with the same card.
